messages.author: 6b8cf45b65614c5b
messages.subject: Bootstrapping (BCa) doesn't work
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to run a mediation analysis within a cross-lagged model (i.e., trying to see if another factor mediates one of the significant cross-lagged paths). 
However, when I try to run bootstrapping (BCa) and to get 90% CIs, I am getting a warning and an error message, so I don't think it worked. 

Warning message:
In norm.inter(t, adj.alpha) : extreme order statistics used as endpoints

Error in object.size(obj) : could not find function "object.size"

I've read somewhere that getting this warning message may mean that it's better to use another test because for small datasets, the interval from BCa may be wider than for some other methods. Can anyone please share with me the syntax for other bootstrapping methods which may be appropriate in this case?
I am including my syntax below for reference. 

Thank you so much!

May 

## Testing mediation within a two-wave cross-lagged model

mod2ms<-'

#regressions

smanx_c1~chsex_d1+cage_d1
smanx_m1~chsex_d1+cage_d1
smanx_m2~smanx_m1+smanx_c1+cage_d2

## direct effect (c’ designated as c here), path b1:
smanx_c2 ~ c*smanx_m1 + b1*MSupES + b2*smanx_c1 + b3*cage_d2

##path a1
MSupES ~ a1*smanx_m1

#covariance
smanx_c1~~smanx_m1
smanx_c2~~smanx_m2
cage_d1~~cage_d2
chsex_d1~~cage_d1+cage_d2

#variance
smanx_c1~~smanx_c1
smanx_c2~~smanx_c2
smanx_m1~~smanx_m1
smanx_m2~~smanx_m2
chsex_d1~~chsex_d1
cage_d1~~cage_d1
cage_d2~~cage_d2
MSupES~~MSupES

#intercept
smanx_c1~1
smanx_c2~1
smanx_m1~1
smanx_m2~1
chsex_d1~1
cage_d1~1
cage_d2~1
MSupES~1

### Test Indirect Effects
Indirectfx := a1*b1

### get total effect (c)
Total := c + (a1*b1) 

'

fit2ms=lavaan(mod2ms, data=depanx, se = 'bootstrap', bootstrap=1000L, fixed.x=FALSE, auto.var = TRUE, meanstructure=TRUE, missing= 'FIML')

summary(fit2ms, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE, rsq=TRUE)

fitMeasures(fit2ms, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "cfi", "tli","nfi" ,"srmr"))


## To get rmsea 90% CIs

fitMeasures(fit2ms)
boot.fit2ms <- parameterEstimates(fit2ms, boot.ci.type="bca.simple")
boot.fit2ms

messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: Bootstrapping (BCa) doesn't work
parts:
I don't think you can calculate a true BCa confidence interval with lavaan. As far as I know, bca.simple does not correct for acceleration. However, you can use the boot package if that is important to you. You may be able to get rid of the warning message if you increase the number of bootstraps significantly. You do not need another bootrap method. You only need to change boot.ci.type to request other ci types:
https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/lavaan/versions/0.6-6/topics/parameterEstimates
However, whether this procedure makes sense for fit coefficients like the RMSEA is another question:
https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/0049124192021002004

messages.subject: Re: Bootstrapping (BCa) doesn't work
parts:
Try

boot.fit2ms <- parameterEstimates(fit2ms, boot.ci.type="bca.simple", level = .90, output = “pretty”)
boot.fit2ms

Does that remove the first warning?
